newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - July 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - July 21.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on July 21. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Thirteen people drowned and another 11 required medical treatment after an overloaded ferry sank off South Sulawesi in the latest of a string of fatal public transport accidents.
The death toll in the crash of a Fokker F-27 operated by Sempati Air has reached 30 after another passenger died in hospital on Sunday.

The Econit Advisory Group has called on the Salim group to put the national interest first and not transfer its stake in noodle maker PT Indofood Sukses Makmur to another company it controls in Singapore as the move undermines confidence in Indonesia and could prompt capital flight.
Local badminton players made a clean sweep of all the catergories in the finals of the Indonesian Open held in the Central Java city of Solo.
